$comment: Time-boxed allowlist for abandoned Composer packages. Every entry MUST carry an 'expires' date (YYYY-MM-DD). scripts/ci/assert-abandoned-policy.php fails the build when an entry is past its expiry, and also fails for any abandoned package that is NOT listed here.

policy.rationale: Abandoned packages are tolerated only when (1) they are dev-only, (2) no replacement exists, and (3) an explicit expiry forces a re-review. Production/runtime dependencies are never allowed to be abandoned.

allowed.name: doctrine/annotations
allowed.reason: Transitive dev-only dependency of phpbench/phpbench (^1.4 resolves to 1.7.0, the latest release, which requires doctrine/annotations ^2.0). Packagist suggests no replacement. Not present in any runtime code path.
